title: 韩国市场基本面强劲 杠杆产品监管趋严
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Some of the details on those measures have not been released yet, so we kind of just know about them in vague terms.
segments.zh: 这些措施的一些细节尚未公布，所以我们只是大致了解。

segments.en: Is this too little too late in terms of the damage that the rat has already done?
segments.zh: 考虑到已经造成的损害，这是否为时已晚？

segments.en: Probably, and I think, you know, there are basically three large areas of leverage ETFs.
segments.zh: 可能吧，我认为基本上有三个大的杠杆ETF领域。

segments.en: US listed, Hong Kong listed, and now Korean listed, and they've only really been listed in Korea since around May,
segments.zh: 美国上市、香港上市，现在韩国上市，而它们大约从五月起才在韩国上市。

segments.en: and we've seen a huge amount of money going. So, you know, we started off the beginning of the year with not that much in these leverage ETFs, and we peaked at about 55 billion, and now we're about 26 billion.
segments.zh: 我们看到大量资金涌入。年初时这些杠杆ETF规模不大，峰值时约550亿，现在约260亿。

segments.en: I think the Korean regulations are more about the amount of money you put down initially. That will continue to go up, and also about the amount of diversification in your portfolio and maybe education for investors.
segments.zh: 我认为韩国监管更多是关于初始投入金额，这将继续上升，还有**组合的分散程度，或许还有市场参与者教育。

segments.en: But it won't stop the leverage ETFs in the US and in Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 但这不会阻止美国和香港的杠杆ETF。

segments.en: So I think short term, it's going to help, but I don't think it's the main stabilization of the market.
segments.zh: 所以我认为短期内会有帮助，但我不认为这是市场稳定的主要因素。

segments.en: And let me, I think that the leverage ETFs have been a little, you know, stigmatized here.
segments.zh: 而且，我认为杠杆ETF在这里有点被污名化了。

segments.en: Because at the end of the day, what's going on in Korea is just that there's these two stocks there that are so coveted because of AI, right?
segments.zh: 因为归根结底，韩国的情况只是有两只因AI而备受追捧的权益资产。

segments.en: People have figured, AI is going to grow. It needs memory. These two stocks are basically white hot.
segments.zh: 人们认为AI会增长，它需要内存。这两只权益资产基本白热化。
